eligibility: Author final 95 ROIs, 8 treatment-naive patients. ND is normal ductal epithelium; PDAC denotes cancer in stroma, NOT stromal cells. Remove author-flagged Stroma_063_003. All ROIs retained regardless of LYPLA1 signal.
filter: Author-style global LOQ = exp(mean(log(NegProbe-WTX))) * exp(sd(log(NegProbe-WTX),ddof=1))^2 across final 95 ROIs; endogenous genes above LOQ in >10 ROIs. No imputation.
primary_expression: Q3 normalization of ProbeQC counts using retained endogenous genes: counts / ROI Q3 * geometric mean(Q3); log2(normalized counts+1). This is our reanalysis, not author's DESeq2 normalization.
sensitivity_expression: Author fully_batch_corrected_vsd (patient and batch ComBat regression; transformed scale, not fold change)
log2(CPM+1) using sum of retained endogenous counts
independent_unit: Patient. Average log-expression over ROIs within each patient/group, then equally weight patient differences. Combined cancer pools all cancer ROIs within each patient.
test: Two-sided exact sign-flip permutation of mean paired difference; enumerate all 2^n signs, zeros included. Assumes exchangeable symmetric differences; observational, not randomized.
interval: 20000 paired-patient percentile bootstrap samples, descriptive with small n
multiple_testing: Four prespecified contrasts form one BH family per expression scale. Unevaluable contrasts retained with NA; BH over evaluable contrasts. Not genome-wide FDR. Secondary scales are sensitivity analyses, not independent replications.
robustness: Count positive/negative patient differences and min/max leave-one-patient-out mean difference; above-global-LOQ ROI fraction descriptive only, not single-cell detection rate.
residency: Matrices, ROI measurements and per-patient measurements stay on server165. Export aggregate results only.
scope_limit: No pure stroma/immune control, no single-cell localization, no healthy-donor inference. Cohort overlap with earlier PDAC data not verified.
